reason: The free page costs me nothing so I would read it, but $950 to $2,500 is real money for something I cannot see yet, and in a normal week I have got a truck payment and two quotes out that matter more.
objection: I cannot tell whether your fix is worth $950 until it is done, and if it flops I have still burned the $250 up front and weeks of my own time testing it.
would_change_my_mind: Show me the one page on my own numbers first, with a hard dollar figure on the quotes I am losing, and let me pay the whole $950 at the end after it passes instead of $250 up front.
